World sabko break karta hai; phir kuch broken places pe strong bante.
Hero woh hai jo apni life kisi apne se bada cheez ko de deta hai.
Himmat mein genius aur shakti hai.
Himmat struggle mein grow karti.
Grit baar-baar jeetna hai.
Chunauti mein himmat dhoondo.
Silence reminder hai: breathe kar.
Khamoshi gehri hoti hai.
Himmat aur aqal saath chalte.
Grit—setbacks endure karne ki taqat.
Silence wisdom ki loudest voice hai.
Khamosh himmat zordaar ko hara deti hai.
Kabhi kabhi humein chup rehna chahiye.
Dharti ka sabse bada courage test—defeat jhelna bina heart lose kiye.
Jeetne ke liye, tumhe ek battle ko ek se zyada dafa ladna pad sakta hai.
Safalta antim nahi hai, vipalta ghatak nahi hai: aage badhte rehne ka saahas hi maayne rakhta hai.
Kabhi kabhi silence sabse best answer hota hai.
